text: {"lessons":["My account fell from NT$101,258 to NT$95,091 overall, despite some positive months; short-term gains and losses are noisy, not reliable forecasts.","I made no trades, which avoided impulsive reactions, but I should still review whether my holdings and cash fit my long-term plan.","Because losses feel especially painful, I should avoid panic-selling and make deliberate decisions based on risk and goals rather than the latest account value."]}
